## What is Feng Shui?
Feng Shui is the ancient Chinese practice of arranging spaces to harmonize with natural energy (Qi). It influences health, wealth, relationships, and overall well-being by optimizing the placement of furniture, doors, windows, and other elements in living and working spaces.

## Key Topics Covered
- Home Feng Shui: Bedroom layout, kitchen positioning, living room energy flow
- Wealth Feng Shui: Financial positions, money plants, office desk orientation
- Relationship Feng Shui: Bedroom harmony, peach blossom positions, love enhancement
- Career Feng Shui: Office layout, desk placement, career advancement tips
- Moving & Renovation: Auspicious dates, pre-renovation Feng Shui check
